youtube_short.title: Your 401k Default Fund Is Draining $127K
title_alternatives: 72% of Workers Never Change This — It Costs $127,000
The 401k Default Trap Nobody Warns You About
youtube_short.description: Most employers auto-enroll you into a target date fund charging around 0.80% per year. Right next to it in your plan sits an index fund at 0.03% — same market, nearly identical returns, 27 times cheaper in fees. On $300,000 over 25 years, that fee gap compounds to $127,000 gone — not from bad investments, just from fees. And target date funds pile you into bonds in your thirties, which grow slower than stocks and cost another $40,000 in growth. Log into your 401k, find your fund's expense ratio, and if it's above 0.1% — switch to your plan's lowest-fee index fund. Takes ten minutes. Could be worth six figures. #401k #retirementplanning #personalfinance #moneytips #financialliteracy
